abstract: The invention discloses a wearable lower limb exoskeleton robot, which belongs to the technical field of medical rehabilitation instruments and comprises a hip height adjusting device and an exoskeleton device. The hip height adjusting device comprises a height adjusting assembly and a gravity center floating device; the gravity center floating device comprises a U-shaped frame, a hip connecting rod and a guide rail; the U-shaped frame is installed on the height adjusting assembly, and the guide rail is installed on the U-shaped frame. The hip connecting rod is provided with a through hole and can float up and down along the guide rail; one end of the hip connecting rod abuts against the waist of the patient; the exoskeleton device comprises a thigh driving mechanism, a shank driving mechanism and a sole supporting mechanism; the thigh driving mechanism is mounted on the hip connecting rod through a hip joint connecting plate; the shank driving mechanism is mounted on the thigh driving mechanism; and the sole supporting mechanism is mounted on the shank driving mechanism. Through the hip height adjusting device, the lower limb exoskeleton robot can float up and down along with the height change of the gravity center of a patient in the walking process, and the rehabilitation training effect is improved.
source_title: Wearable lower limb exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive admittance control method for a lower limb rehabilitation exoskeleton robot, and the method comprises the following steps: importing an expected trajectory, and collecting human-computer interaction force information; inputting the interaction information into a threshold judgment function and then outputting a judgment result; the judgment result is input into a self-adaptive admittance controller of optimal parameters of the improved whale optimization algorithm; and the self-adaptive admittance controller updates and outputs motion information for controlling the exoskeleton robot to act according to the input judgment result. According to the self-adaptive admittance control method of the lower limb rehabilitation exoskeleton robot, the adaptability and flexibility of an active rehabilitation training mode can be improved.
source_title: Self-adaptive admittance control method of lower limb rehabilitation exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention provides a force feedback remote operating system and method based on an exoskeleton data glove and a remote control lever. The remote operating system based on the exoskeleton data glove and the remote control lever comprises the exoskeleton data glove, the remote control lever, a far-end robotic arm and a processing control unit. The exoskeleton data glove and the remote control lever are respectively used for tracking finger joint angles and hand positions of a user and meanwhile used for achieving sensible force feedback on a finger part and a whole arm. The processing control unit comprises a sensor circuit and an upper computer system. The upper computer is used for analyzing and processing acquired user motion information and sending a control signal to a controller ofthe far-end robotic arm to complete corresponding operation. In addition, a force sensor located on the robotic arm can transmit the pressure of the tail end of the robotic arm to the upper computersystem in real time, and then the pressure is fed back to a wearer through the exoskeleton data glove and the remote control lever, so that more comprehensive and real force feedback is realized. Theremote operating system and method can be applied to the aviation field, the industrial field, the medical field, the teaching field, the entertainment field, and the like.
source_title: Remote operating system and method based on exoskeleton data glove and remote control lever

abstract: The invention belongs to the field of flexible exoskeleton robots, and specifically discloses a single-motor flexible power-assisted knee joint exoskeleton. The single-motor flexible power-assisted knee joint exoskeleton comprises a fixing module, a back module, flexible ropes and two knee modules, wherein the fixing module is connected with the back module; a rotating shaft of a motor in the backmodule is connected with an upper belt wheel and rotates forwards or backwards under the control of a control box so as to drive the upper belt wheel to rotate; the upper belt wheel and a lower beltwheel are meshed and connected with synchronous belts separately, and the upper belt wheel drives the lower belt wheel to rotate through the synchronous belts; two clamping blocks are meshed and fixedwith the synchronous belts at the left side and the right side separately so as to move oppositely under the driving of the synchronous belts; the two knee modules are the same in structure, fixed tothe left knee and the right knee of a wearer through flexible kneepads separately, and connected with the two clamping blocks through the flexible ropes separately. According to the single-motor flexible power-assisted knee joint exoskeleton, restraint on the lower limbs is greatly reduced, so that the flexibility is improved; and meanwhile, a single-motor alternating power-assisted manner is adopted for the back module. The single-motor flexible power-assisted knee joint exoskeleton has the advantages of being simple in structure, stable in work and low in energy consumption.
source_title: Single-motor flexible power-assisted knee joint exoskeleton

abstract: The present invention relates to high-functional clothes for a clothes-type wearable robot to prevent an actuator from being exposed to the outside and a wearable robot applied with the same. According to the present invention, the clothes applied to a wearable robot comprises: a base layer worn by a user as a bottom and made to be fit to the shape of a user's body from the waist to the knee; a waist belt part located at the waist part of the upper end of the base layer; and a thigh part disposed on the lower thigh part of the base layer and connected to the waist belt part and a power transmission part. The base layer has one pattern in which the front and the back are integrated and the base layer, the waist belt part, and the thigh part have an integrated form.
source_title: Clothing-type wearable robot with Functional garments using Wire driven device

abstract: The invention is applied to the technical field of exoskeleton robots, and provides a method, device and system for determining the position of a landing point, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the walking motion state information of a user between the current heel off-ground moment and the adjacent last heel off-ground moment, three-dimensional environment point cloud data, collected at the current heel off-ground moment, in the walking direction of the user is obtained; determining a probability distribution function representing an initial landing point position of an adjacent next foot target point according to the motion state information; according to the three-dimensional environment point cloud data, determining a foot falling area of an adjacent next-time target point of the foot; updating the probability distribution function according to the sufficient region to obtain an updated probability distribution function; and determining a target landing point position of the adjacent next foot target point. According to the method, the probability distribution function is updated according to the landing area, the updated probability distribution function can be effectively fused with the environment information, and therefore the landing point position in the complex environment can be accurately determined.
source_title: Method, device and system for determining position of landing point

abstract: The invention provides a waist assistance control method and system for an aerial work exoskeleton robot and the exoskeleton robot. The control method comprises the steps that actual tension data of a chest belt of a safety belt, angular velocity data of a boosting rod, weight data of an operator and friction damping coefficient data are obtained; substituting the actual tension data, the angular velocity data, the weight data and the frictional damping coefficient data into a tension compensation algorithm, and calculating to obtain control torque data and a theoretical tension value; and updating the control torque data by using a tension compensation algorithm according to a difference value between the theoretical tension value and the actual tension data until the difference value is zero. Actual pulling force data of a chest belt of a safety belt are collected in real time, human body weight data and angular velocity data of a boosting rod are combined, a theoretical pulling force value is accurately calculated through a pulling force compensation algorithm, output torque is dynamically adjusted according to the difference value between the theoretical value and an actual value, and it is ensured that the actual pulling force value is rapidly converged to the theoretical value. And real-time dynamic compensation of the backward stretching moment of the waist of the human body is realized.
source_title: Aerial work exoskeleton robot waist assistance control method and system and exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention provides an exoskeleton mechanical arm based on series-parallel joints. The exoskeleton mechanical arm comprises a shoulder joint mechanism, a big arm mechanism, an elbow flexion and extension joint, a small arm mechanism and a wrist joint mechanism which are sequentially connected in series. The shoulder joint mechanism is a three-degree-of-freedom series connection mechanism and comprises a shoulder abduction and adduction joint, a first shoulder joint connecting rod mechanism, a shoulder inward rotation and outward rotation joint, a second shoulder joint connecting rod mechanism and a shoulder flexion extension joint which are sequentially connected in series; the rotation center lines of the shoulder abduction and adduction joint, the shoulder extorsion and intorsion joint and the shoulder flexion and extension joint are perpendicular to one another and intersect at one point. The wrist joint mechanism is a three-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism. The compact design of the structure of the exoskeleton robot can be achieved, meanwhile, the structural design combining series connection and parallel connection better conforms to the human body movement effect, and the comfort of an operator in the using process is improved.
source_title: Force feedback exoskeleton mechanical arm based on series-parallel joint

abstract: The invention relates to an upper limb exoskeleton robot, and belongs to the technical field of exoskeleton robots. The invention discloses a spinal column support which comprises a waist support part, a pair of shoulder fixing parts, a spinal column assembly used for connecting the waist support part and the shoulder fixing parts, and arm support parts rotationally mounted on the shoulder fixing parts, the spine assembly comprises a first adjusting mechanism used for adjusting the distance between the waist supporting piece and the shoulder fixing pieces and a second adjusting mechanism used for adjusting the distance between every two adjacent shoulder fixing pieces. The arm supporting piece comprises a supporting arm rod used for supporting an arm and a third adjusting mechanism used for adjusting the length of the supporting arm rod. The exoskeleton robot has the effect of improving the fitting degree of the exoskeleton robot to the human body.
source_title: Upper limb exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of robots, and provides an online control method and device for an exoskeleton robot, equipment and a medium. The online control method comprises the following steps: modeling an exoskeleton robot based on a fuzzy rule to obtain a TS fuzzy model; fusing fuzzy rules of the TS fuzzy model, and projecting the fused TS fuzzy model to a high-dimensional space to obtain an exoskeleton robot control model; according to the training data, solving a consequent parameter of the exoskeleton robot control model; determining a relational expression between the output torque of the controller and the joint angle according to the solved subsequent part parameters; and controller output torque calculation is conducted on the expected joint angle at the T moment through the relational expression, and a controller of the exoskeleton robot is controlled at the T moment according to the calculated controller output torque. According to the online control method, the control performance of the exoskeleton robot can be effectively improved.
source_title: Online control method, device and equipment of exoskeleton robot and medium

abstract: The invention provides an exoskeleton robot impedance adjustment and trajectory planning method, a medium and equipment, and relates to the technical field of exoskeleton robot control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a multi-dimensional original signal related to exoskeleton movement, and carrying out the preprocessing of the multi-dimensional original signal; the exoskeleton complex motion trail is decomposed into a basic motion component and a working condition adaptive component; adjusting the Fourier coefficient of the abnormal harmonic wave to suppress the abnormal harmonic wave, and obtaining an anti-interference basic motion component according to the adjusted Fourier coefficient; performing topographic feature matching and gain control on the working condition adaptive component to obtain a reconstructed working condition adaptive component; the anti-interference basic motion component and the reconstruction working condition adaptive component are recombined to obtain a final motion track; according to the error between the final motion track and the expected track of the exoskeleton, adjusting parameters of the impedance model in real time, so that the exoskeleton tracking expected track is optimized in real time. According to the method, the application scene of the exoskeleton can be widened, and the practicability of the exoskeleton in a complex environment is remarkably improved.
source_title: Exoskeleton robot impedance adjustment and trajectory planning method, medium and equipment

abstract: This invention relates to a robotic exoskeleton comprising mechanical linkages that couple to one or more selected joints of a limb of a subject. The robotic exoskeleton may be provided with means for obtaining data respecting angular position, torque, and/or acceleration of at least one of the j oints or the links of the mechanical linkages, and may be used for assessing, studying, diagnosing a deficit, and/or treating an impairment in sensorimotor function of a limb of a subject.
source_title: ROBOTIC EXOSKELETON FOR LIMB MOVEMENT

abstract: A wearable robot may be worn by a user to record or teach a motion, including a motion such as sign language. The wearable robot includes a mode to record sign language data in a system by a sign language expert wearing the wearable robot and a mode to teach the sign language data recorded in the system to a sign language learner wearing the wearable robot. A user who wishes to learn sign language may easily learn sign language. In particular, a disabled person, who has poor eyesight and is unable to watch a video that teaches sign language, may learn sign language very intuitively using the wearable robot. Further, a user who has normal eyesight may also learn sign language more easily than from using a video which teaches sign language or from a sign language expert.
source_title: WEARABLE ROBOT AND TEACHING METHOD OF MOTION USING THE SAME

abstract: According to the present invention, an interface of a wearable robot and an impedance measurement robot including the same comprise: a first arm which is connected to an end of a robot body to be integrated into the robot body, includes a first insertion coupling unit on one side thereof, and has a first pin hole formed on the first insertion coupling unit in a direction perpendicular to an insertion coupling direction of the first insertion coupling unit; a second arm which is connected to a wearing unit worn by a person to be integrated into the wearing unit, includes a second insertion coupling unit arranged on one side thereof and inserted and coupled to the first insertion coupling unit of the first arm to be connected to the first arm to be integrated, and has a second pin hole formed on the second insertion coupling unit to be joined to the first pin hole of the first arm; a safety pin which is inserted into the first pin hole and the second pin hole after the first insertion coupling unit and the second insertion coupling unit are inserted and coupled to fix the first arm and the second arm, and can be separated from the first pin hole and the second pin hole; a pin compression unit which is arranged on at least one among the first pin hole and the second pin hole, and compresses the safety pin inserted into the first pin hole and the second pin hole by an elastic force; and an elastic body arranged between the first insertion coupling unit of the first arm and the insertion coupling unit of the second arm. According to the present invention, the wearing unit and the robot body can be quickly separated in emergency.
source_title: Interface of wearable robot and robot of impedance measurement using the same

abstract: An embodiment wearable robot includes a rear body unit configured to be provided in close contact with a rear side of a user, the rear body unit including a first link, and a link module having a first side coupled to the rear body unit and a second side configured to be positioned on a shoulder of the user, the link module including a second link rotatably coupled to a first side of the first link, a third link rotatably coupled to a second side of the first link, and a fourth link having a first side rotatably coupled to the second link and a second side rotatably coupled to the third link, the fourth link being configured to extend to the shoulder of the user.
source_title: Wearable Robot

abstract: The invention discloses an enhanced type lower limb exoskeleton robot system which comprises an energy supply unit, a control unit, a driving unit and an exoskeleton structure, the exoskeleton structure comprises a rack, the top of the rack is fixedly connected with a back connecting rod, and the rack and the outer wall of the back connecting rod are jointly and fixedly connected with a back backup plate. The outer wall of the back connecting rod and the outer wall of the back backup plate are jointly provided with a shoulder bearing frame, a plurality of waist transverse rods are arranged onthe outer wall of the rack in a penetrating mode, waist connecting rods are symmetrically connected to the two ends of the multiple waist transverse rods together, and hip joints are arranged at one ends of the waist connecting rods. The landing type lower limb exoskeleton robot system can be worn by a load-bearing operator and can provide support and movement assistance for a wearer, a landing type structure in direct contact with the ground is adopted, thus the load of the wearer can be effectively reduced, and the labor intensity of the wearer is reduced.
source_title: Enhanced type lower limb exoskeleton robot system

abstract: The invention discloses a control method and device for stable walking of an exoskeleton robot, and the method comprises the steps: building a state space expression of an augmentation system based on a crutch-free self-balancing lower limb exoskeleton robot model; based on a state space expression of the augmented system, an on-policy data driving Q learning algorithm based on a state feedback PI strategy is used to solve a control problem; according to the on-policy data driving Q learning algorithm based on the state feedback PI strategy, system state information measured along a system track is utilized, and a cost function and a control law in a dynamic planning method are approached through continuous iteration updating, so that the optimal control problem is solved online in real time. According to the walking-stick-free self-balancing lower limb exoskeleton robot, the exoskeleton robot can still walk stably under the condition that the physical parameters of the user are unknown, and therefore the application range and the actual application value of the walking-stick-free self-balancing lower limb exoskeleton robot are improved.
source_title: Control method and device for stable walking of exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention discloses a pneumatic type single-arm upper limb exoskeleton robot and a control system. The robot comprises an elbow joint exoskeleton mechanical arm used for containing an upper arm and a front arm of a wearer; the elbow joint exoskeleton mechanical arm comprises a first artificial pneumatic muscle and a compression type air spring; the first artificial pneumatic muscle and the compression type air spring are used for providing driving torque for the elbow joint exoskeleton mechanical arm. The pneumatic single-arm upper limb exoskeleton robot provided by the embodiment of the invention has a certain fault-tolerant capability, that is, when the elbow joint exoskeleton mechanical arm is in a working state, if sudden faults such as air leakage occur to the manual pneumatic muscle, a wearer can still enable the arm to restore to the initial position by virtue of the action of the compression type air spring, so that the mechanical arm can be recovered to the initial position. And sports injury is avoided.
source_title: Pneumatic single-arm upper limb exoskeleton robot and control system

abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb exoskeleton robot for relieving knee joint cartilage injury and a use method thereof, and relates to the technical field of manipulators, the lower limb exoskeleton robot comprises a control system assembly, a pressure sensing module and an execution mechanism, the control system assembly comprises a gas pumping assembly, and the execution mechanism comprises a bag body fixing assembly and a force application bag body; the force application bag body is fixed on the two plate bodies at the same time; the force application capsule body comprises a capsule body main body and an exhaust assembly; the bag body main body is a cylindrical bag, an exhaust port is positioned on the bag body main body, and the exhaust component opens the exhaust port to exhaust part of gas in the bag body main body when the gas pumping component is in a non-operation state; the technical effects that the lower limb exoskeleton robot is high in cruising ability, good in portability, small in burden on the human body when no power exists and convenient to put on and take off are achieved.
source_title: Lower limb exoskeleton robot for relieving knee joint cartilage injury and use method

abstract: The present embodiment relates to a wearable robot which comprises: a wearable body worn by a user; an actuator spaced apart from the wearable body; a cable which is connected with the wearable body and the actuator; and a sensor module through which the cable penetrates. The sensor module comprises: a sensor housing which has a penetration hole through which the cable penetrates and a space inside thereof; a slider which is stored to be movable inside the space; at least one roller which is installed on a slider to be rotatable and supports the cable; a spring which elastically supports the slider; and a force sensor which senses force applied on the cable. The wearable robot minimizes a weight and a volume by transmitting external force through the cable and reliably controls the external force applied on the cable.
source_title: Wearable Robot

abstract: The invention relates to a series elastic driver suitable for a flexible upper limb rehabilitation exoskeleton robot. The series elastic driver comprises a rack, a motor, an elastic element, a bearing, an output shaft and an encoder device. The rack is used for achieving connection and fixation of the series elastic driver and an upper-stage mechanism and installation of the motor. The driver is formed by integrating a direct-current servo motor and a harmonic reducer, and a compact structure is achieved. Motor torque reaches the input end of the elastic element after passing through the harmonic reducer and then is transmitted to a lower-stage mechanism through the output end of the elastic element and the output shaft. And the elastic element realizes corresponding deformation while transmitting torque, so that impact can be buffered, and smooth driving is realized. The encoder is an absolute value encoder, can measure and record angle signals, is installed on the elastic element and is used for measuring the deformation quantity of the elastic element and providing feedback signals for control. Energy can be absorbed through deformation, and impact is effectively relieved. And meanwhile, the encoder is combined, so that the external load can be measured and sensed according to the deformation.
source_title: Tandem elastic driver suitable for flexible upper limb rehabilitation exoskeleton robot

abstract: Disclosed is a height-adjustable waist link of a wearable robot secured with a user-centered human interface for adjusting a height according to a physical condition of a user. The waist link comprises: a body part; a locking part disposed on one side of the body part of the body part to lock or release the body part for height adjustment of the body part; and a handle connected to the locking part to execute locking or unlocking.
source_title: Waist link having adjustable height and Wearable robot having the same

abstract: The technical muscles are a simulation of human and animal muscles. They are designed as network muscles and formed by a flexible container and a net which is not stretchable lengthwise. The container can be filled with a liquid or a gas. As a result it expands and shortens the longitudinal extension of the net. This force is utilised technically. The tubular muscle or multiple (multi)tube muscle is designed as a thin-walled elongate tube which has a tensioning and filling/draining device on both ends. During filling, the wall becomes spherically convex and shortens the stretch length. Application of the technical muscles as prosthetic muscles, lifting/tensioning device, spring tensioner and adjuster, positioner and muscle motor, and as robot. For use, a tensioning and filling valve is required. Control is effected via pressure and drainage lines. These are actuated electronically and by control valves. The electronics comprise sensors, receivers and computers. Simple controls are possible mechanically. The pressure is achieved by a pump or gravity/gradient. <IMAGE>
source_title: Technical simulation of the biological muscle principle as a technical muscle. Robot resembling an animal or a human being and having technical muscles. Parts of this robot as prostheses. Further applications of the muscle: as lifting and tensioning device, as muscle motor, for positioning of an object by several muscles, as adjustment means for the range of spring

abstract: Related is a folding work unit for an industrial wearable robot, comprising: a vertical frame fixated in a backpack unit of the wearable robot, wherein an upper body can be installed to be folded to the left and right direction on a lower body; a horizontal frame installed in front of an upper end of the vertical frame, wherein a front body can be installed to be folded to the left and right direction in a rear body, and the rear body can simultaneously be installed to be folded to the up and down direction on the upper body of the vertical frame; a motor fixated on the lower body of the vertical frame; a winch drum accessed to the motor; and a wire rope wherein an end portion is accessed to the winch drum and a heavy product accessed to the other end portion discharged to the front direction of a lower end of the front frame of the horizontal frame. When there is no heavy product work, the vertical and horizontal frames are folded to the backpack unit, thereby securing a worker′s mobility.
source_title: FOLDING WORKING UNIT FOR WEARABLE ROBOT

abstract: The invention provides a light and flexible knee joint power-assisted exoskeleton robot. The robot comprises shoulder straps, a waistband, a controller, a power supply, hip flexible binding straps, leg structures and knee joint driving units. Each leg structure comprises an outer side supporting structure, an inner side supporting structure, a thigh rear side protector, a shank rear side protectorand leg binding parts. A mechanical structure scheme of knee joint direct drives, leg bilateral supports, thigh and shank shape adjusting structures and thigh and shank inner side flexible deformation structures and a binding scheme of shoulder binding parts, a waist binding part, the hip flexible binding straps and leg flexible binding parts are fused, man-robot matching and torque transmissioneffectiveness are improved from two aspects of the mechanical structure and the binding parts, the man-robot matching problem can be well solved, unexpected force generated in the torque transmissionprocess is reduced, the contact area between a man and the robot is increased, and the effects of improving the wearing comfort, stability and power assisting efficiency are achieved.
source_title: Light and flexible knee joint power-assisted exoskeleton robot

abstract: PURPOSE: A hinge for a joint of a wearable robot is provided to improve durability by obtaining a reaction force and a supporting force even if the hinge is rotated to the maximum permission angle. CONSTITUTION: A hinge(50) for a joint of a wearable robot comprises a first coupling unit(10) and a second coupling unit(20). The first coupling unit is formed to both sides by separating from the other end of a connecting unit in a specific distance to the mutually symmetrical direction. The first coupling unit includes a fixing groove(14) formed to the inside in a specific depth. An inner guide unit(18) and an inserting guide unit(30) are formed in inner circumference of the fixing groove and outer circumference of an inserting end unit(24) of the second coupling unit. The inner guide unit and the inserting guide unit have a spiral structure inserting by mutually inserting. The inserting end unit is inserted into the inside of the fixing groove and is installed to be rotated. An inserting end unit in a specific height is formed to both directions from the other end of the connecting unit.
source_title: Hinge for wearable robotics

abstract: The invention provides an exoskeleton robot, a walking assisting control method, a terminal and a computer device. The exoskeleton robot comprises at least one movable joint, a sensor arranged on themovable joint and used for acquiring motion information of the movable joint, and a controller connected with the sensor, wherein the controller is used for receiving motion information, generating gait data according to the motion information and transmitting the gait data to the terminal through a communication unit, so that the terminal determines walking assisting control parameters accordingto the gait data. By applying the technical scheme, the gait situation of a user is known by the user and professionals such as medical staff in real time, then, the health and rehabilitation state ofthe user are evaluated, professional suggestions are proposed, the walking assisting control parameters suitable for the current user are determined in a targeted mode, the pertinence and scientificity of walking assisting and gait correction are effectively improved, and thus the walking assisting and gait correction effects of the exoskeleton robot are greatly improved.
source_title: Exoskeleton robot, walking assisting control method, terminal and computer device

abstract: The invention relates to an exoskeleton robot and a controller system thereof. The exoskeleton robot comprises a back pad, a waist ring, a left thigh assembly, a right thigh assembly, a left calf assembly, a right calf assembly, a left shoe part and a right shoe part. The back pad is connected with the waist ring and located above the waist ring; the left thigh assembly and the right thigh assembly are connected with the left side and the right side of the waist ring through corresponding hip joint assemblies; the left thigh assembly and the right thigh assembly are connected with the left calf assembly and the right calf assembly through knee assemblies; and the left shoe part and the right shoe part are connected with the left calf assembly and the right calf assembly through ankle jointassemblies. The exoskeleton robot is mainly used for human body load supporting, the load capacity of a human body can be greatly improved, and the exoskeleton robot is easy to wear, fits human bodymechanics and greatly improves the fit degree with a user.
source_title: Exoskeleton robot and controller system thereof

abstract: PURPOSE: A variable link of a wearable robot is provided to effectively absorb shock which is instantaneously delivered to the link of a wearable robot. CONSTITUTION: A variable link(10) of a wearable robot comprises a joint pipe(18), an arm(14), a hydraulic tool(13), and a protection cap(15). The joint pipe is equipped with a joint(16) by one side and forms a hollow which is internally opened with both sides. The arm is exposed to the outside of the joint pipe. The exposed end of the arm supports the wearable robot by being in a close contact to the ground. The hydraulic tool is built in the joint pipe in order to come in contact with the end of the arm. The protection cap shields one opening part of the joint and arm.
source_title: VARIABLE LENGTH LINK OF WEARABLE ROBOT

abstract: The invention relates to a rescue exoskeleton robot for an active assistant armored vehicle. The rescue exoskeleton robot comprises upper limb assistant modules which are arranged on two sides of an adjustable back connecting module. A retractable base module is arranged below the adjustable back connecting module. A lower limb assistant module is arranged at the connection of the adjustable backconnecting module and the retractable base module. The rescue exoskeleton robot is simple in structure and convenient to wear, the quantity of rescue personnel can be reduced, the rescue efficiency can be improved, and precious rescue time is strived for the wounded. Upper limb structures and the base module of the rescue exoskeleton can be retractable and can be folded if not being used, so thatthe occupied area is reduced.
source_title: Rescue exoskeleton robot for active assistant armored vehicle

abstract: The invention discloses a device for improving the hip joint extension assisting efficiency of a flexible exoskeleton robot. The device comprises a base, the cam-like pressing rod mechanisms, a rotating block, a telescopic rod outer sleeve, a telescopic rod inner rod, a telescopic rod limiting screw, a telescopic rod locking sleeve and a Bowden cable guide pipe. One end of the rotating block is installed in the base through one cam-like pressing rod mechanism, the other end of the rotating block is connected with one end of the telescopic rod outer sleeve, and the other end of the telescopic rod outer sleeve sleeves one end of the telescopic rod inner rod; the telescopic rod locking sleeve sleeves the joint of the telescopic rod outer sleeve and the telescopic rod inner rod, a radial through hole is formed at the tail end of the other end of the telescopic rod inner rod, and the Bowden cable guide pipe is mounted in the radial through hole through a positioning screw. According to thedevice, the angle between a Bowden cable and the thigh is increased, the power assisting efficiency is improved, and the safety is higher.
source_title: Device for improving hip joint extension assisting efficiency of flexible exoskeleton robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a serial elastic actuator installed at an auxiliary arm of a lower extremity exoskeleton robot. More specifically, the serial elastic actuator includes: an auxiliary arm installed on one side of an exoskeleton robot; a four-bar link part provided on one side of the auxiliary arm and installed at one end of the exoskeleton robot; a joint part linked with one side of the four-bar link part; a moving frame having one side linked with the other side of the four-bar link part, and having the other side connected with the joint part; a ball screw inserted into a support part formed in the center of the moving frame; a first pulley provided on one side of the moving frame; a second pulley spaced apart from the first pulley by a predetermined distance; and an actuator axially combined with the second pulley, and connected with the first pulley through a driving belt to deliver a driving force to the first pulley. Therefore, the present invention is capable of controlling a predetermined distance between a user and a clamped object.
source_title: Series elastic actuator installed on the auxiliary arm of the lower extremity exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton robot. The exoskeleton robot comprises two parallel supporting rods, the lower surfaces of the two supporting rods are rotationally connected with two movable joint mechanisms respectively, the side walls of the opposite sides of the two movable joint mechanisms are each symmetrically fixedly connected with two fixing mechanisms respectively, and the lower ends of the two movable joint mechanisms are rotationally connected with two foot placement mechanism respectively. The invention relates to the exoskeleton robot. In the specific using process, the feet of a user are placed in the foot placement mechanism, the four fixing mechanisms fix the thighs and the shanks of the user respectively, the waist of the user is fixed with a waist supporting mechanism, when the exoskeleton robot is subjected to rehabilitation training in use, a positioning mechanism limits the footstep moving angle of the user, and the situation that some patients who suffer from weakness of lower limbs or lower limb disorder cannot control footsteps to fall down during rehabilitation is avoided.
source_title: Exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention discloses a hip and knee integrated joint device used for an exoskeleton robot and the exoskeleton robot. The device includes a thigh connection rod used as a thigh of the human body, the upper end of the thigh connection rod is rotatably connected with a hip joint connection rod through a hip joint driving unit, and the lower end of the thigh connection rod is rotatably connected with a crus connection rod through a knee joint driving unit. The hip joint driving unit comprises a first gear motor, the knee joint driving unit includes a second gear motor, the first gear motor and the second gear motor are respectively fixed on the upper end and lower end of the thigh connection rod respectively, the lower end of the hip joint connection rod is fixed to a rotating flange surface of the first gear motor, and the upper end of the crus connection rod is fixed to a rotating flange surface of the second gear motor. The thigh connection rod, the hip joint driving unit, the hip joint connection rod, the knee joint driving unit and the crus connection rod form an integrated joint. Compared with the prior art, the hip and knee integrated joint device has the advantages that the modularization and generalization of exoskeleton robot products are achieved.
source_title: Hip and knee integrated joint device used for exoskeleton robot and exoskeleton robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a grip for a wearable robot that a worker can hold with his or her hand to lift an object from a wearable robot that can be worn on the worker's body and assist the worker in his/her work. The grip for a wearable robot worn on the human body and provided with a driving unit that generates power comprises: a coupling unit coupled to a wearable robot; a main body unit connecting the coupling unit to one side and capable of being held by a worker by hand; an operation unit provided at one end of the main body unit and capable of operating the driving unit; and a control unit provided inside the main body unit to remotely operate the driving unit by receiving an electrical signal from the operation unit.
source_title: GRIP FOR WEARABLE ROBOT

abstract: A method for controlling a wearable robot by detecting motion intention based on a brain machine interface performed by a computer device, comprises the steps of: (a) applying different tactile stimuli to left feet and right feet of a user wearing the wearable robot, respectively; (b) acquiring a user′s brain signal presented due to imagine motion and the tactile stimuli; (c) determining motion intention corresponding to the brain signal based on the brain signal and a brain signal classifier; (d) transferring an output value of the brain signal classifier and motion intention with respect to each motion to a control command receiver so that the user confirms the output value of the brain signal classifier and the motion intention; and (e) controlling both feet, a walking speed and a walking width of the wearable robot by the control command receiver so that the wearable robot performs a function corresponding to the motion intention. The brain signal classifier includes a motion noise classifier, a walking start intention classifier, and a motion intention classifier generated based on a brain signal collected from the user, and determines whether the motion intention is one of a plurality of motions by passing the brain signal as an input.
source_title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING WEARABLE ROBOT BY DETECTING MOTION INTENTION OF USERS BASED ON BRAIN MACHINE INTERFACE

abstract: The invention discloses an action following control method and system of a wearable robot and a storable medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the following steps: realizing following control of the wearable robot through constructing a tracking differentiator, improving an inverse dynamics control model and a joint torque representation model; enabling the wearable robot to follow the movement of the wearer in real time; according to the invention, the control instruction more suitable for the actual working condition of the lower limb wearable robot can be generated.
source_title: Action following control method and system of wearable robot and storable medium

abstract: The present invention relates to a wearable robot, comprising: an upper frame including a back plate coming in contact with the rear of a user's upper body and a core part capable of selectively adjusting the position of the back plate in a height direction; a lower frame coupled to the upper frame, worn on the user's lower body, and including a pivotal shaft and a joint rotatable in different axial directions from each other; and a cylinder fixed to the upper frame and elastically providing tension to a cable extending to the joint according to movement between the upper frame and the lower frame. The wearable robot according to the present invention can flexibly respond to physical conditions and can be used for medical and industrial purposes.
source_title: PASSIVE TYPE WEARABLE ROBOT

abstract: Disclosed are a robot and a control method thereof. The robot can be a wearable robot provided so as to be detachable from a user′s body and assists in the body movement of the user. The robot can comprise: a control part; a sensing part for sensing the position and posture of the user and transmitting them to the control part; and an actuator which receives a command from the control part and operates to move the position of a joint of the robot. The control part can generate a movement trajectory of the joint of the robot in order to move each joint of the robot to be disposed at the position of the joint of the corresponding user based on the information regarding the position and posture of the user received from the sensing part. The robot can transmit and receive wireless signals on a mobile communication network established according to a 5G (Generation) communication.
source_title: ROBOT AND CONTROL METHOD THEREOF

abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of rehabilitation robots, and provides an exoskeleton type upper limb rehabilitation robot which comprises a main body module, a big arm module and a small arm module, the main body module comprises a robot base, a supporting part and a shoulder joint movement mechanism, and the shoulder joint movement mechanism is supported on the ground through the main body part and achieves lifting control; the big arm and the small arm are based on the shape of an arm and belong to a linear mechanism, and the big arm module is connected with the main body module to realize fixation and rotation of the big arm; the small arm module is connected with the large arm module and used for driving the elbow joint to rotate inwards/outwards and bend/stretch and the shoulder joint to rotate inwards/outwards. According to the exoskeleton type upper limb rehabilitation robot, through reasonable and compact motor arrangement, basic requirements can be met, the overall structure of the robot is more compact, the size is smaller, and the requirements of actual application scenes are met.
source_title: Exoskeleton type upper limb rehabilitation robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a lower extremity exoskeleton robotic device which is used for rehabilitation exercises, etc. The lower extremity exoskeleton robotic device according to the present invention comprises: a pelvis supporting part (10) formed to support the rear side surface of the pelvis of a human body (10); a waist supporting part (20) installed and connected to the upper side of the middle of the pelvis supporting part (10) to support the rear side surface of a waist; a hip joint supporting part (30) connected below both sides of the pelvis supporting part (10) to support both side surfaces of a hip joint; a hip joint rotating part (40) formed at the lower end of the hip joint supporting part (30) to enable a hip joint to rotate; a thigh supporting part (50) installed and connected below the hip joint rotating part (40) to support both the side surfaces and the rear side surface of a thigh; a calf supporting part (60) installed and connected below the thigh supporting part to support both the side surfaces and the rear side surface of a calf; a knee rotating part (70) formed at the upper end of the calf supporting part (60) to enable the rotation of a knee; and a sole supporting part (80) installed and connected below the calf supporting part (60) to support a sole.
source_title: Lower extremity exoskeleton robotic device

abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton device and an exoskeleton variable admittance control method, and is applied to the field of exoskeleton robots. The exoskeleton device is composed of bent rigidstructure mechanical arms, mechanical hard limiting and photoelectric soft limiting are adopted for joints, when a motion range of an exoskeleton system exceeds a set safety interval, a rigid limiting column can shield an infrared photoelectric sensor so as to generate a soft limiting signal, and when the photoelectric soft limiting does not achieve the protection effect, the mechanical hard limiting is performed through the rigid limiting column, so that the safety of an operator is guaranteed. According to the device and the method, an admittance model based on virtual damping and virtual rigidity is also established, admittance adjustment strategies under different frequencies are designed, a variable admittance controller is used as a force control outer ring, a backstepping controller is used as a position control inner ring, and the designed exoskeleton device is controlled, so that the variable admittance control over the exoskeleton device is achieved, the man-machine interaction force is effectively reduced, and the assistance effect is improved.
source_title: Exoskeleton device and exoskeleton variable admittance control method

abstract: The invention provides a mining exoskeleton robot with embracing and shoulder-carrying type material carrying functions. The mining exoskeleton robot comprises a back plate, a hip joint assembly, a left lower limb, a right lower limb, a first driving device and a second driving device. The materials are conveyed to the ground through the back plate, the first driving device, the second driving device, the left lower limb and the right lower limb, and the material carrying function is completed. The hip joint assembly comprises a left hip and a right hip; the left hip and the right hip are both installed on the back plate. A first driving device is additionally arranged outside an original motor between a left lower limb and a left hip, and a second driving device is also additionally arranged between a right lower limb and a right hip. Triangles are formed among the first driving device, the left hip and the left lower limb and among the second driving device, the right hip and the right lower limb. The characteristic that a triangle has stability is utilized, the first driving device and the second driving device provide additional assistance between the hip joint assembly and the lower limb, then the exoskeleton can provide enough power for supporting the weight of materials in a mining scene, and the mining requirement is met.
source_title: Mining exoskeleton robot with embracing and shoulder-carrying type material carrying functions

abstract: Disclosed are systems and methods for controlling walking of a wearable robot, which provide walking assistive power as if something were pulling the wearer of the robot from the front or pushing the wearer from the back, by applying the force of a virtual spring, whereby the wearer may comfortably walk. The systems for controlling walking of the robot include: a walking mode determination unit configured to determine whether the robot is walking; a virtual spring force calculation unit configured to calculate the force of a virtual spring of which one end is connected to the robot and the other end is connected to a target point in front of the robot based on the walking direction; and a joint driving unit configured to drive each joint of the robot using torque calculated based on the force of the virtual spring, which is calculated by the virtual spring force calculation unit.
source_title: Method and system for controlling walking of wearable boot

abstract: An adaptive assistive and/or rehabilitative device may be configurable for use with another assistive device, such as a wearable assistive device. When the wearable assistive device is a robotic device such as an exoskeleton, the adaptive assistive and/or rehabilitative device may be transformed into a first configuration for charging or storing the exoskeleton, a second configuration for transport of the exoskeleton, a third configuration for assistance in donning of the exoskeleton by a user, and a fourth configuration for assisting the user while standing or walking with the exoskeleton.
source_title: ADAPTIVE ASSISTIVE AND/OR REHABILITATIVE DEVICE AND SYSTEM

abstract: The invention relates to the field of rehabilitation robots and discloses an exoskeleton robot waist adjusting device. The exoskeleton robot waist adjusting device comprises a back waist plate, firsttelescopic mechanisms, connection plates, second telescopic mechanisms and side waist plates. Two groups of the first telescopic mechanisms, the connection plates, the second telescopic mechanisms andthe side waist plates are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the back waist plate. The first telescopic mechanisms are connected between the back waist plate and the connection plates, and at least one connection end of each first telescopic mechanism is in rotational connection. The second telescopic mechanisms are connected between the connection plates and the side waist plates, and at least one connection end of each second telescopic mechanism is in rotational connection. The exoskeleton robot waist adjusting device has the advantage that waist width, thickness and connection anglesof exoskeleton robots can be adjusted on the premise that structural rigidity is guaranteed.
source_title: Exoskeleton robot waist adjusting device

abstract: The invention discloses a lower-limb exoskeleton robot with four-connecting-rod knee joints. The lower-limb exoskeleton robot comprises hip joints, the knee joints and ankle joints; one ends of the hip joints are connected with waist connecting pieces, the other ends of the hip joints are connected with the knee joints through thigh supporting pieces, and the hip joints are connected with the ankle joints through shank supporting pieces; the knee joints comprise knee joint upper supporting blocks, knee joint lower supporting blocks, first knee joint swing plates and second knee joint swing plates; the knee joint upper supporting blocks and the knee joint lower supporting blocks are hinged through the first knee joint swing plates and the second knee joint swing plates correspondingly to form four-connecting-rod structures; and first sliding grooves used for adjusting the length of the shank supporting pieces are formed in the knee joint lower supporting blocks. The ankle joints of lower-limb exoskeletons are in active linear driving and passive auxiliary mechanism modes, the auxiliary supporting capacity to the ankle joints is effectively improved, and a wearer can be helped to walk more conveniently.
source_title: Lower-limb exoskeleton robot with four-connecting-rod knee joints

abstract: The invention discloses a heavy-load under-actuated parallel lower-limb assisting exoskeleton with elastic buffer, and relates to a lower-limb assisting exoskeleton which solves the problems that an existing lower-limb assisting exoskeleton robot is great in weight, is poor in load capacity and is low in travelling speed. The heavy-load under-actuated parallel lower-limb assisting exoskeleton comprises a back part, a waist part, a left leg, a right leg and foot parts, wherein the back part is connected with the waist part; the two sides of the waist part are separately connected with the left leg and the right leg; the left leg and the right leg are connected with the corresponding foot parts; the waist part is rotatably connected with the back part; each of the left leg and the right leg comprises an ankle joint and two sets of flexion and extension swing telescopic structures; the two sets of flexion and extension swing telescopic structures are separately arranged at the two ends of the waist part; each set of flexion and extension swing telescopic structures comprises hip joint flexion and extension swing telescopic mechanisms and series-parallel connection telescopic mechanisms; and each hip joint flexion and extension swing telescopic mechanism is mounted on the waist part, and can rotate front and back relative to the waist part. The heavy-load under-actuated parallel lower-limb assisting exoskeleton is used for an exoskeleton robot.
source_title: Heavy-load under-actuated parallel lower-limb assisting exoskeleton with elastic buffer

abstract: The invention provides a single-motor hip bone joint exoskeleton, and relates to the technical field of robots, the single-motor hip bone joint exoskeleton comprises a waist fixing mechanism, a power driving mechanism, a leg assisting mechanism and a control mechanism electrically connected with the power driving mechanism; the waist fixing mechanism is used for adjusting the waistline to be tightly attached to the human waist in the circumferential direction. The leg assisting mechanism comprises a first leg assisting part and a second leg assisting part which are symmetrically arranged along the central axis of the power driving mechanism, one end of each of the first leg assisting part and the second leg assisting part is in transmission connection with the power driving mechanism, and the other end of each of the first leg assisting part and the second leg assisting part is fixedly connected with a human leg; the adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting the horizontal relative distance between the first leg assisting part and the second leg assisting part; the power driving mechanism is located on the outer side of the right rear portion of the waist fixing mechanism, fixedly and detachably connected with the waist fixing mechanism and used for driving the first leg assisting part and the second leg assisting part to alternately swing in a reciprocating mode and assisting walking of the legs of the human body.
source_title: Single-motor hip bone joint exoskeleton

abstract: The present invention provides a machine learning-based wearable robot control apparatus and system, capable of precisely controlling a wearable robot by more accurately detecting a user motion by giving a weight to motion data of a user affecting the classification of behavior classes. The machine learning-based wearable robot control apparatus according to the present invention comprises: a machine learning unit for learning training data collected by a plurality of behavior classes through machine learning to obtain and store first motion data; a motion information acquisition unit for acquiring second motion data for a user motion through at least two sensors; a motion prediction unit for predicting a behavior class of the user motion corresponding to the second motion data on the basis of one or more acceleration values and angular speed values used by machine learning to generate the first motion data when the first motion data and the second motion data are compared and matched in a matching standard; and a control command generation unit for extracting a control command for controlling a user wearing robot pre-mapped to the behavior classes.
source_title: DEVICE AND SYSTEM FOR CONTROLLING WEARABLE ROBOT BASED ON MACHINE LEARNING

abstract: The invention relates to an upper limb active power-assisted exoskeleton robot which comprises a back plate and two power-assisted mechanisms. The two power-assisted mechanisms are distributed at the left end and the right end of the back plate respectively. The power assisting mechanism comprises a shoulder sliding assembly, a driving assembly and an arm transmission assembly. The shoulder sliding assembly comprises a sliding rail, a sliding block and a connecting piece. And the sliding rail is arranged on the back plate. The sliding block is arranged on the sliding rail in a sliding mode and can slide in the left-right direction. The connecting piece is arranged on the sliding block. The driving assembly comprises a mounting part, a driving motor and an output part. The driving motor is arranged in the mounting component, and an output shaft of the driving motor is connected to the arm transmission assembly through the output component. The installation part is hinged to the connecting piece, and the hinged axis is vertical. The arm transmission assembly is connected to the output component and can be connected with the upper limbs of the user so as to assist the user in lifting under the driving of the driving motor. When the exoskeleton robot is used, the smoothness and comfort are high.
source_title: Upper limb active power-assisted exoskeleton robot

abstract: Robotic exoskeleton with self-adjusting sliding elbow support for human arm. The invention relates to a robotic exoskeleton that allows the user to move comfortably and perform medical therapies, assisted orthotic forces, activities related to sports practices or specialized training that require sequences of movements, daily tasks, or services of firemen, police, military, etc. Assisted in force by the exo-skeleton. The system consists of a vest (1), to which are attached the exo-arm (8), the exo-forearm (7), a support structure (2, 3, 4, 5), with sliding parts (5)., 31) and hinges (10) actuated, which allows to track the displacements of the shoulder with respect to the body and offers a solid mobile support point in addition to a passive weight compensation system using spindles (22), with power actuators (9) that allow to move the articulated arm in a controlled manner. The device also comprises an autonomous power supply system (11) and a control unit. (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
source_title: Robotic exoskeleton with self-adjusting sliding elbow support for human arm (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)

abstract: Disclosed is an ankle joint system having an impact absorbing and balance supporting mechanism, wherein the ankle joint system supports ankle muscular strength and absorbs an impact at the same time. The ankle joint system of a wearable robot has the impact absorbing and balance supporting mechanism and is operated by one or more of a pitch degree of freedom, a yaw degree of freedom, and a roll degree of freedom. The ankle joint system comprises a foot plate unit, a floor plate, a support unit, an ankle link, an ankle assembly unit, and a rolling hinge.
source_title: Angle joint assembly of Wearable robot

abstract: The invention discloses a head joint of a power-assisted exoskeleton robot and the power-assisted exoskeleton robot. The head joint is mounted on a base of the power-assisted exoskeleton robot and comprises an external mounting bracket and an electric supporting assembly, wherein the supporting assembly is arranged between the external mounting bracket and the base, and the electric supporting assembly is provided with a plurality of moving shafts and can drive the external mounting bracket to do multi-axis motion. The head joint further comprises a follow-up controller, and the follow-up controller is electrically connected with the electric supporting assembly to control the electric supporting assembly to operate so that the external mounting bracket can move along with the head of a user. According to the head joint of the power-assisted exoskeleton robot and the power-assisted exoskeleton robot, by arranging the external mounting bracket and the electric supporting assembly, the user can mount a load or an external device to the external mounting bracket, the electric supporting assembly provides auxiliary supporting force for the external mounting bracket, thus the load borneby the head of the user is greatly reduced or the head of the user does not need to bear an extra load, and the head burden of the user is greatly relieved.
source_title: Head joint of power-assisted exoskeleton robot and power-assisted exoskeleton robot

abstract: An improved robotic contractile device having, besides general industrial and other-wages applicability for automation and other purposes, particularly attractive utility in and for prosthetic appliances and which is characterizable in being able to function in a way remarkably analogous to that of biological muscle is structurally made up of an expandable conduit which is contractible on fluid inflation with a plurality of longitudinally-directed filaments peripherally-secured thereabout that are connectable with an object to be moved or displaced as a result of the contractability experienced upon inflation of said conduit; there being associated means in the device for introducing and exhausting fluid under pressure to the interior of the said conduit in order to inflate same to effectuate its motive contraction action and deflate it to its normal rest condition of maximum or intermediate extension. The way of using the device takes advantage of the cooperative interaction of its constructional components and means.
source_title: Robotic fluid-actuated muscle analogue

abstract: Disclosed is an electronic device. The electronic device comprises: a communication interface; and one or more processors that obtain safety template information including different types of a plurality of pieces of context information, dangerous situation information mapped to each of the plurality of pieces of context information, and control information mapped to each dangerous situation, when at least one piece of sensing data is received from at least one user device through the communication interface, identify context information corresponding to the at least one piece of sensing data, identify dangerous situation information on the basis of the safety template information and the type of context information, identify whether a surrounding environment of a wearable robot corresponds to a dangerous situation corresponding to the identified dangerous situation information on the basis of the at least one piece of sensing data, when it is identified that the surrounding environment corresponds to the dangerous situation, obtain at least one piece of control information mapped to the dangerous situation on the basis of a safety template, and control the wearable robot or at least one of user devices on the basis of the obtained at least one piece of control information.
source_title: ELECTRONIC DEVICE FOR PERFORMING SAFETY FUNCTION AND CONTROL METHOD THEREFOR

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an electromyographic signal classification method, an exoskeleton robot control method and an electromyographic signal classification device. The electromyographic signal classification method comprises the steps that an electromyographic signal is acquired, and active segment of the electromyographic signal is segmented by adopting a plurality of sliding windows with different lengths, so that a plurality of sub-signal segments corresponding to the active segment are obtained, and feature extraction is performed on the sub-signal segments, the featuresof the sub-signal segments are combined to obtain a first feature corresponding to the active segment, dimensionality reduction processing is performed on the first feature to obtain a second feature, and then the second feature is input into a pre-trained classifier to enable the classifier to output the type of the electromyographic signal. In the scheme, the plurality of sliding windows with different lengths are adopted to segment the active segment, the active segment is divided into the plurality of sub-signal segments with different lengths, and the features obtained by performing feature extraction on the multi-length sub-signal segments are more comprehensive and accurate than features obtained by performing feature extraction on single-length signal segments, so that the classification result is more accurate.
source_title: Electromyographic signal classification method, exoskeleton robot control method and electromyographic signal classification device

abstract: A hip joint exoskeleton robot belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises a waist binding piece, leg binding pieces, driving mechanisms and executing mechanisms, the two driving mechanisms are installed on the front portion of the waist binding piece, and the executing mechanisms are installed on the two sides of the waist binding piece respectively; each driving mechanism controls the corresponding executing mechanism through a steel wire rope arranged in the Bowden cable pipe. Each actuating mechanism comprises a shell, an outer connecting disc, a rope wheel, a connecting plate and two transition wheels; the connecting plate is rotationally connected with the waist binding piece; the rope wheel and the two transition wheels are rotatably arranged on the same side face of the connecting plate respectively, the two transition wheels are connected into a whole, the outer connecting disc is installed on the side face of the rope wheel, the shell is installed on the connecting plate and provided with a space enabling the outer connecting disc to rotate, and a steel wire rope is wound around a wheel groove of the rope wheel and wheel grooves of the two transition wheels. According to the invention, collaborative optimization of topological configuration and high power density driving is realized, and balance of light weight and large torque output is realized.
source_title: Hip joint exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention provides a passive exoskeleton robot assisted by a shoulder joint. The passive exoskeleton robot comprises a back plate, a waist plate, a back rod assembly, arm assemblies and power-assisted joint assemblies, wherein the back plate and the waist plate provide ergonomic support for the back and the waist of a wearer, the back rod assembly is used for connecting the back plate and thewaist plate, and the back rod assembly, the back plate and the waist plate jointly form a bionic spine mechanism based on human engineering, the arm assemblies are fixed to the rear portion of the back plate and comprise at least one unilateral-arm assemblies used for supporting the power-assisted joint assemblies and effectively transmitting arm loads to the back, the power-assisted joint assemblies are connected with the tail end of the arm assemblies in an embracing mode, and auxiliary torque used for gravity compensation is generated to support the arm load of the wearer. According to thepassive exoskeleton robot, through the design of the power-assisted joint assemblies, the flexible output capacity of super-large auxiliary torque is achieved, the proper auxiliary torque can be output at any working angle, sudden change or impact is avoided, and the output torque is improved by several times compared with an existing exoskeleton of the same type.
source_title: Passive exoskeleton robot assisted by shoulder joint

abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton robot trajectory planning method based on human body parameters and states, and relates to the technical field of trajectory planning. Comprising the steps of collecting gait data of healthy individuals, generating a standard gait database, and complementing gait data of special individuals; in the early rehabilitation stage of the patient, an adaptive joint angle track is generated according to the standard gait track and the adjustment coefficient; after the patient has certain muscle ability, the gait track is adjusted in real time in a mode of combining off-line planning and on-line adjustment; and when the patient is judged to have the complete gait ability through the quantitative evaluation index, the exoskeleton provides assisting power at a specific phase of a gait cycle, and bottom layer servo control adopts a force control mode. By designing the shoulder joint angle limiting device, the rotation angle of the shoulder is effectively limited, arms are prevented from making contact with the chest of the human body in the rotation process, and therefore the safety of a user is greatly improved.
source_title: Exoskeleton robot trajectory planning method based on human body parameters and states

abstract: The invention discloses a walking aid exoskeleton cooperative control device based on a CPG network and a control method of the walking aid exoskeleton cooperative control device. The control device comprises an angle acquisition component, a CPG network component and a gait mutation recognizer. The angle acquisition component acquires angles of hip joints, knee joints and naked joints of a wearer; the CPG network component comprises three CPG network units, the three CPG network units respectively acquire angles of a hip joint, a knee joint and a naked joint of a wearer, and gait curve self-adaptive iteration is carried out through an internal oscillator to generate and output tracking human body joint angle data; the gait mutation recognizer is connected with the CPG network component and the angle acquisition component and performs correlation analysis on human joint angle data and angle data of the angle acquisition component, and the CPG network component and the gait mutation recognizer are connected with a driver of the walking-aid exoskeleton robot and control the driver according to the human joint angle data. The method has the advantages that the method has the advantage of predicting all-phase space, and the problems of insufficient adaptability and robustness can be solved.
source_title: Walking-aid exoskeleton cooperative control device based on CPG network and control method of walking-aid exoskeleton cooperative control device

abstract: A wearable robot device includes a frame, a detector provided on the frame for collecting information on a force applied from a user, a controller for determining a required amount of torque necessary for an operation of the wearable robot device based on the information collected by the detector, and for determining a sound corresponding to the required amount of torque, and an output unit for outputting the determined sound.
source_title: Wearable robot device and method of controlling the wearable robot device

abstract: The invention relates to an early warning device and an early warning method for dynamic edge clamping control of an exoskeleton robot, and relates to the technical field of exoskeleton robot safety, on one hand, the invention discloses the early warning device for dynamic edge clamping control of the exoskeleton robot, the early warning device is arranged at a joint position of the exoskeleton robot, and the early warning device comprises a plurality of sensors and a controller, the acquisition module is used for acquiring multiple parameters of a joint position in real time; the edge calculation unit is used for setting a dynamic early warning interval corresponding to each parameter in advance, receiving the parameters of all the sensors in real time, and comparing the plurality of parameters with the respective dynamic early warning intervals; and the buzzer is used for giving an alarm. The invention further discloses an early warning method for dynamic edge clamping control of the exoskeleton robot. According to the early warning device and the early warning method, accurate early warning is carried out on the sensor data in a dynamic edge card control mode, and the accuracy and the safety are greatly improved.
source_title: Early warning device and early warning method for dynamic edge clamping control of exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of wearable equipment, and particularly relates to a flexible wearable ankle joint power-assisted robot which comprises a pressure sensing shoe, an assistance measuring device, a shank bandage, a longitudinal bandage, a thigh bandage, a flexible tension rope, a waist flexible wearable garment, a control driving system, a power transmission system and aposture sensing module. The control driving system excites the power transmission system, force is transmitted to the assistance measuring device along the flexible tension rope, and power assistanceof the ankle joint is conducted according to the sole pressure and the gait of a wearer. According to the flexible wearable ankle joint power-assisted robot, the defects that a common exoskeleton power-assisted robot is large in inertia, poor in wearing comfort, short in endurance time and the like are overcome, and the flexible wearable ankle joint power-assisted robot is light in overall weight,convenient to wear, good in comfort and fitness, high in power-assisted efficiency and capable of adapting to different terrains such as flat ground, soil, gravel, stairs and slopes.
source_title: Flexible wearable ankle joint power-assisted robot

abstract: The lower limb assisting exoskeleton robot comprises two sets of skeleton modules which are oppositely arranged, each skeleton module comprises a mounting frame and a skeleton structure arranged at the bottom of the mounting frame, each skeleton module further comprises a waist limiting structure, and each waist limiting structure comprises a front waist limiting rod and a side waist limiting rod; the front waist limiting rods are installed on the front side frame bodies of the corresponding installation frames, the front waist limiting rods of the two skeleton modules extend oppositely till the cantilever ends of the front waist limiting rods are close to each other, and the side waist limiting rods are connected to the corresponding front waist limiting rods and extend towards the rear sides of the front waist limiting rods. The positions of the side waist limiting rods on the corresponding front waist limiting rods are adjustable, and the adjusting direction is parallel to the axial direction of the front waist limiting rods. The waist of an operator can be reliably restrained and protected, the situations of shaking, instability and the like of the operator due to factors such as incoordination of the lower limbs and the upper body are reduced, then the situations of falling and the like of the operator are reduced, and the safety of electric power high-altitude operation is improved.
source_title: Lower limb power-assisted exoskeleton robot for electric power high-altitude operation

abstract: Disclosed is a lower limb exoskeleton robot. The lower limb exoskeleton robot comprises a left leg exoskeleton, a right leg exoskeleton and a hip width adjustable assembly; the left leg exoskeleton and the right leg exoskeleton are symmetrically installed on the left side and the right side of the hip width adjustable assembly respectively; each of the left leg exoskeleton and the right leg exoskeleton comprises a thigh rod piece, a shank rod piece, a hip joint actuator, a knee joint actuator and a pedal plate; the thigh rod piece is in linkage with the hip joint actuator; the knee joint actuator is installed at the tail end of the thigh rod piece; the shank rod piece is fixedly installed on the knee joint actuator; and the shank rod piece is in linkage with rotation output of the knee joint actuator. The invention provides the lower limb exoskeleton robot which aims at improving the body type adaptability and interaction comfort in the wearing process.
source_title: Lower limb exoskeleton robot

abstract: The adjustable suspension support comprises a suspension support body, a fixing block, two connecting plates and the exoskeleton robot, the fixing block is located on the front side of the suspension support body, the two connecting plates are located on the left side and the right side of the fixing block respectively, and the front sides of the connecting plates are fixedly connected with the rear side of the exoskeleton robot. A containing groove is formed in an inner cavity of the fixing block, and a positioning mechanism used in cooperation with the exoskeleton robot is arranged in an inner cavity of the containing groove. Through cooperative use of the suspension bracket, the fixing block, the connecting plate, the exoskeleton robot, the placement groove, the positioning mechanism and the transmission mechanism, the problem that in the existing use process, if the leg length of the exoskeleton robot is large, the leg length of the exoskeleton robot needs to be shortened, so that the leg length of the exoskeleton robot can be matched with the suspension bracket, and the use cost is reduced is solved.
