And therefore, the problem that a user cannot conveniently adapt the exoskeleton robot to a suspension bracket for use is solved.
source_title: Adjustable suspension bracket for suspending exoskeleton robot

abstract: PURPOSE: A wearable robot for assisting muscular strength is provided to have a foot link which minimizes pressure on the ankle of a wearer even though the ankle joint part of the robot is formed as a manual joint. CONSTITUTION: A wearable robot for assisting muscular strength includes a waist wearing part which is worn at the waist part of a wear; a leg supporting part which assists the movement of the femoral region or shin of the wearer; and a foot link(160) which is combined with one end of the leg supporting part and is worn at the foot of the wearer. The foot link includes a foot combining member(161) which is combined with the leg supporting part; a foot frame(162) which is extended from the foot combining member; a foot supporting member(163) which is formed in order to contact with the ground when the wearer stands; and a footwear fixing part(164) which is combined with the footwear of the wearer.
source_title: Wearable robot to assist muscular strength

abstract: The invention relates to a passive energy feedback driving device for a rehabilitation robot. The passive energy feedback driving device comprises a right frame, a left frame, a bottom plate, a moving column, a partition plate, a one-way piece, a positioning shaft and a connecting line. Positioning holes are formed in the bottom plate, and the right frame, the left frame and the partition plate are connected and positioned with the bottom plate through matching of the shafts and the positioning holes to form a left channel, a right channel, an upper through opening and a lower through opening. A one-way piece hole is formed in one side of the partition plate, and the one-way piece is arranged in the one-way piece hole, so that the movable column can move in the left channel in a two-way mode and can only move in the right channel in a one-way mode. The one-way piece is composed of a connecting piece and a rotating piece, and a protruding part is arranged in the connecting piece to limit the rotating angle of the rotating piece. The moving column is connected with the connecting line, the connecting line can drive the moving column to move in the left channel and the right channel, and the moving column cannot pass through the upper through opening and the lower through opening. The device further comprises a bottom plate, a take-up bearing and a connecting wire. The take-up bearing is arranged on the bottom plate, the connecting wire is connected into the take-up bearing, the take-up bearing is provided with a built-in spring, and when the connecting wire is pulled out, the connecting wire can be automatically taken up. Through the passive energy feedback driving device, the problem that a passive driving exoskeleton is not fixed when the opportunities for collecting energy and feeding back energy are different can be solved, the energy consumption of a system is reduced, and the purposes of improving the movement efficiency of a human body and promoting the rehabilitation of motor nerves of the human body are achieved.
source_title: Passive energy feedback driving device for rehabilitation robot

abstract: A hand exoskeleton device is provided having at least three robotic units. One is for attachment to the thumb and has two elements for attachment to the distal and proximal phalanges. The other two each have three elements, for attachment to the distal, middle and proximal phalanges of the index and middle fingers. The elements of each robotic unit are interconnected by suitable hardware to provide for relative angular movement of the elements about an axis of rotation that corresponds substantially to the axis of rotation of a user's interphalangeal joint movement. An actuator is associated with the interconnecting hardware to enable adjustment of the two elements in each of two opposite directions. A sensor senses the angular position or force of one element relative to the other element of each pair. A computerized controller controls movement of the elements of each pair by means of the associated actuator.
source_title: HAND EXOSKELETON

abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton robot leg mechanism. The exoskeleton robot leg mechanism comprises a hip joint module, a thigh extension module, a knee joint module, a calf extension module and an ankle joint module, wherein two ends of the thigh extension module are rotationally connected with the hip joint module and the knee joint module; and two ends of the calf extension module are rotationally connected with the knee joint module and the ankle joint module. The exoskeleton robot leg mechanism adopts a detachable combination mode, and is convenient in installation and disassembly; and the thigh extension module and the calf extension module capable of continuously adjusting the lengths enable a lower limb exoskeleton robot to adapt to wearing by different crowds, and the leg height of the robot can be adjusted according to persons with different heights to achieve comfortable wearing.
source_title: Exoskeleton robot leg mechanism

abstract: Disclosed herein is a wearable robot with improved operability and mobility through improvement of the upper limb structure thereof. The wearable robot includes an upper limb muscular power assist device to perform an articulation motion with a predetermined degree of freedom, the upper limb muscular power assist device being wearable by a user, and a mobile platform connected to the upper limb muscular power assist device to move according to information regarding movement speed and movement direction of the user in a rolling fashion. Consequently, mobility of the wearable robot and operation efficiency of the user are improved.
source_title: Wearable robot and control method thereof

abstract: PURPOSE: A method and a system for removing the disturbance of wearable robots are provided to correctly deliver the movement intention of a wearer to the robot to be strong in outdoor noise and the disturbance and to expect the correct output relative to the input. CONSTITUTION: A method and a system for removing the disturbance of wearable robots comprises the following steps: calculating request torque to be inputted in a robot joint from the difference of a target angular velocity value of the wearable robot and a current angular velocity value; reversely calculating expected input torque from the current angular velocity value, estimating it, and calculating disturbance torque by removing real input torque from the expected input torque; and calculating real input torque by removing the disturbance from the request torque.
source_title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR ELIMINATING DISTURBANCE OF ROBOT

abstract: The present invention relates to a hydraulic system for supplying a hydraulic pressure so as to operate a wearable robot, which comprises: a tank unit; a first hydraulic pump unit and a second hydraulic pump unit, arranged at the left and right tank respectively so as to supply the actuator of the wearable robot by sucking each hydraulic oil from the tank; a connection unit for connecting to the actuator for the hydraulic oil sucked from the tank unit operated by at least one of the operations of the first hydraulic pump unit and the second hydraulic pump unit; a first servo motor unit, arranged at the left and right side of the tank, and arranged at each upper portion of the first hydraulic pump unit and the second hydraulic pump unit so as to operate the first hydraulic pump unit and the second hydraulic pump unit respectively; and a hydraulic control unit to control a first servo motor and a second servo motor, wherein at least one of the first hydraulic pump unit and the second hydraulic pump unit is to be operated so as to supply hydraulic oil of the tank unit to the connection unit, and to control the connection unit so as to connect the hydraulic oil supplying to the connection unit then to the actuator. To this end, the present invention, compared to the high power of the motor, can reduce the risk of damage affecting the human body when a trouble occurs, and the load can be distributed by the distributed placement of the motor so that the burden of design considering the center of gravity can be reduced.
source_title: Hydraulic system

abstract: An exoskeleton lower limb is provided with an upper connecting end, a leg motion device and a foot connecting device. The upper connecting end is used for receiving loads borne by the upper body of a user. The leg motion device is provided with a first body and a second body. The first body and the upper connecting end are hinged through a first hinged portion. The first body and the second body have relative linear motion. The foot connecting device is worn on the foot of the user and is hinged to the second body through a second hinged portion. The relative linear motion is in the direction of the connecting line between the first hinged portion and the second hinged portion. A wearable robot is provided with a carrying device and exoskeleton lower limbs arranged on the two legs of the user correspondingly. The carrying device is worn on the upper body of the user and is connected with upper connecting ends. The exoskeleton lower limb and the wearable robot are high in adaptive ability and good in motion flexibility.
source_title: Exoskeleton lower limb and wearable robot

abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive load-bearing exoskeleton robot system suitable for a complex terrain of a coal mine tunnel. The self-adaptive load-bearing exoskeleton robot system comprises an exoskeleton main body, a load-bearing assembly and a gravity center adjusting assembly, the exoskeleton main body comprises a lower limb connecting area and a waist and back connecting area which are connected with each other; the load-bearing assembly comprises a box body, a weighing sensor and a load-bearing plate; a storage cavity capable of being opened and closed is formed in the box body; the bearing plate is arranged in the storage cavity and is arranged on the weighing sensor; the weighing sensor is used for measuring the load value of the bearing plate; a low-friction piece is arranged on the periphery of the bearing plate. In the scheme, the low-friction piece can reduce the friction force between the periphery of the bearing plate and the inner wall of the storage cavity, so that the influence of the friction force on the weighing precision of the weighing sensor is reduced. Due to the fact that the weighing precision of the weighing sensor can directly affect the gravity center adjusting precision of the gravity center adjusting assembly, the gravity center adjusting precision of the exoskeleton after load bearing can be improved by arranging the low-friction piece.
source_title: Self-adaptive load-bearing exoskeleton robot system suitable for complex terrain of coal mine tunnel

abstract: The invention provides an exoskeleton power-assisted robot. The exoskeleton power-assisted robot comprises a carry-on-the-back mechanism (10) used for being worn on a human body (200), a bearing mechanism (20) which is used for bearing goods and extends in the horizontal direction, two mechanical legs (40) which are connected to the rear end of the bearing mechanism (20), and two sets of driving mechanisms (30) which are installed on the bearing mechanism (20), wherein the front end of the bearing mechanism (20) is connected with the carry-on-the-back mechanism (10), and the driving mechanisms(30) correspond to the mechanical legs (40) in a one-to-one mode and are used for driving the mechanical legs (40) to walk. The provided exoskeleton power-assisted robot has high load capacity and can adapt to complex and changeable environments.
source_title: Exoskeleton power-assisted robot

abstract: The invention discloses an assisting exoskeleton hip joint structure. A waist main body structure and hip joint structures symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the waist main body structure respectively are disposed, dual-hole structures of a right waist structure member and hip joint pinboard are internally provided with movement connection shafts respectively, the ends of the two movementconnection shafts are fixedly provided with a hip-joint inward and outward stretching movement mechanism and a hip-joint power mechanism respectively, and the hip joint inward and outward stretching movement mechanism and the hip joint power mechanism are connected into a whole part through connection fixing pieces; the lower end of the hip-joint inward and outward stretching movement mechanism isprovided with thigh outer pipes used for being connected with exoskeleton leg knee parts, multi-degree-of-freedom type rigidity-flexibility-combined structures of the hip, knee and ankle joints are achieved, and fitting of the movement state of human joints can be achieved to a greater degree; it is ensured that the joints of an exoskeleton can have highly dynamic characteristics under a compactspace, output power can be precisely controlled, flexible interaction between the structure and the human body can be achieved, unexpected force impact under an uncertain external environment is handled, and the body of a robot is protected.
source_title: Assisting exoskeleton hip joint structure

abstract: The invention discloses a portable elbow exoskeleton robot, comprising a mechanical flexible support, an elastic elbow sleeve, a sensing system and a control system. The mechanical flexible support isput on the elastic elbow sleeve along the length of the elastic elbow sleeve; the sensing system is arranged at one end of the elastic elbow sleeve; the control system is arranged on the elastic elbow sleeve; the output end of the sensing system is connected to the input end of the control system. The portable elbow exoskeleton robot has the advantages that the mechanical flexible support has multiple degrees of freedom, the demand of an elbow for degrees of freedom in different directions during moving can be met, and the portable elbow exoskeleton robot is light in weight and convenient tocarry.
source_title: Portable elbow exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention provides a self-adaptive power-assisted control method for a waist exoskeleton robot, which is characterized in that a hierarchical control system is designed, and an upper-layer parameter generator generates parameters of a complete power-assisted state mode in a middle-layer finite-state machine according to waist buckling angle values and plantar pressure values when different wearers bend down at the lowest points; the middle-layer finite-state machine sets four state modes according to the bending and stretching angles and angular speeds of the waist and back of the human body and the plantar pressure, all the modes can be effectively switched, and the four state modes send different control parameters to the bottom-layer force-position hybrid controller. The force-position hybrid controller can realize single or hybrid control of force positions of the exoskeleton actuator. According to the control method, the characteristics of the working process of the man-machine compatible waist assistance exoskeleton are fully considered, implementation is easy and convenient, assistance parameters can be adjusted in a personalized mode according to the actual operation conditions of different individuals, and the control state diversity and man-machine coordination of the waist assistance exoskeleton are greatly improved.
source_title: Self-adaptive power-assisted control method for waist exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention discloses a backpack upper limb exoskeleton and a shoulder joint coordinated movement tracking design method thereof, the backpack upper limb exoskeleton comprises a strap base, a shoulder joint module, a big arm joint module and a small arm joint module, the shoulder joint module comprises a first drive, a second drive, a first joint, a second joint and a third joint; the first joint is connected to the strap base, and the first drive is arranged between the first joint and the strap base; the second joint is connected to the first joint, and the second drive is arranged between the first joint and the second joint; the third joint is connected to the second joint, the big arm joint module comprises a big arm drive, and the big arm drive is rotationally connected to the third joint; and a synchronous transmission mechanism is arranged among the second joint, the third joint and the big arm driver. The six-degree-of-freedom exoskeleton robot is applied to the field of exoskeletons, five shoulders and one elbow of a person can be tracked only through five drives, the number of the drives is reduced, the weight is reduced, and the manufacturing cost is reduced.
source_title: Backpack upper limb exoskeleton and shoulder joint coordinated movement tracking design method thereof

abstract: The invention discloses an invisible adjustable human body electric power-assisted exoskeleton, and belongs to the technical field of bionic machinery and wearable equipment. The device adopts an innovative knee motor-free design, power-assisted output is realized through a waist motor driving unit and a flexible transmission structure, the legs are completely hidden in the trousers during wearing, and high invisibility is realized. The core innovation of the robot includes that the design of the multi-degree-of-freedom movable joints supports complex actions such as lateral movement and going up and down stairs; the lengths of the thighs and the shanks can be adjusted to adapt to users with different heights; the intelligent control system provides an automatic mode, a foot feeling mode, a slow walking mode and a fast walking mode and supports stepless speed regulation. Real-time gait recognition based on a leg sensor ensures natural and smooth man-machine coordination. The problems that a traditional exoskeleton is heavy, conspicuous and stiff in joint are effectively solved, and the exoskeleton has remarkable application value in the fields of medical rehabilitation and military operation and has the advantages of concealment and movement flexibility.
source_title: Human body electric power-assisted exoskeleton

abstract: A mesofluidic powered robotic and/or prosthetic finger joint includes a first finger section having at least one mesofluidic actuator in fluid communication with a first actuator, a second mesofluidic actuator in fluid communication with a second actuator and a second prosthetic finger section pivotally connected to the first finger section by a joint pivot, wherein the first actuator pivotally cooperates with the second finger to provide a first mechanical advantage relative to the joint point and wherein the second actuator pivotally cooperates with the second finger section to provide a second mechanical advantage relative to the joint point.
source_title: MESOFLUIDIC CONTROLLED ROBOTIC OR PROSTHETIC FINGER

abstract: The exoskeleton robot comprises an auxiliary assembly, the auxiliary assembly comprises a mounting frame, two sets of first driving joints are mounted on the outer wall of the mounting frame and symmetrically mounted on the two sides of the mounting frame correspondingly, and second driving arms are mounted through the first driving joints; the second driving arm is of a two-section split type design. By arranging the auxiliary assembly, after the battery is installed, a limiting fixing groove of the auxiliary assembly can be clamped through a limiting clamping block for limiting and fixing, the situation that normal energy supply is affected due to unnecessary sliding displacement of the battery in the using process is avoided, and the battery can be rapidly disassembled by shifting the limiting clamping block to relieve limiting and fixing of the battery when disassembly is needed; according to the technical scheme, traditional bolt type fixing is not needed, the mounting and dismounting speed can be effectively increased, the mounting and dismounting convenience is improved, the efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the use convenience is greatly improved, and the use comfort can be improved.
source_title: Exoskeleton robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a wearable robot control system capable of enabling a user to wirelessly control the driving condition of a wearable robot using a mobile communication terminal such as a smartphone or a tablet PC. According to the present invention, the wearable robot control system makes a technical feature of including a wearable robot unit for generating mechanical power and for sensing the movement of the user; and a user terminal unit for transmitting a driving control signal to the wearable robot unit and for receiving the driving sensing signal of the wearable robot unit.
source_title: CONTROL SYSTEM FOR WEARABLE ROBOT
